content.aboutTitle: Call Fadi, and Fadi turns up
content.about:
It's a small local business, so the plumber you speak to is the plumber at your door.

You get the price before any work starts, and the job is cleaned up before he leaves.

faqs.a: Usually yes. Call in the morning and we'll fit you in the same day.
